{{Top|leg}}
'''''Amgis''''' were a pair of [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

'''Amgis''' were dispatched to pick up two [[Class-A cargo container|Cargo containers]] that contained munitions stolen from an Imperial armory. Despite enemy fire they were protected by [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and managed to recover the containers and bring them back to the Empire. The events regarding this were recorded in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future pilots such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

==Behind the scenes==
Amgis is Sigma backwards.
